title: "19 - Sensitivity to 2025 Reporting Completeness"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console

# Purpose

The primary priority metric uses mean posterior transmission intensity during 2024-2025.
Because late-2025 surveillance may still be incomplete, this sensitivity rebuilds the
transmission component using two alternative windows:

1. **2024 only**
2. **2023-2024**

and compares both against the primary **2024-2025** ranking.

The severity-burden component is held fixed at the File 13 definition. This intentionally
isolates sensitivity to the recent transmission window rather than changing multiple parts
of the metric at once.

Primary comparison: municipality ranking stability of the expected-burden score

`combined_burden = T_irr * V_burden`

Secondary comparison: ranking stability of `T_irr` itself.

No INLA refit is performed. This file uses the saved monthly posterior IRR surface from
the primary model.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("00_paths.R")
ensure_results_dir()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

EXPECTED_N_MUNI <- 5570L
TOP_N <- ceiling(EXPECTED_N_MUNI / 3)

RESULT_ROOT <- RESULTS_DIR
OUT_DIR <- file.path(RESULT_ROOT, "reporting_completeness_sensitivity")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ST_RATE_PATH <- file.path(
  RESULT_ROOT,
  "st_rate_chik_region_2016_2025.rds"
)

PRIMARY_PRIORITY_PATH <- file.path(
  RESULT_ROOT,
  "priority_rule_evaluation_municipality_2024_2025.csv"
)

required_files <- c(
  ST_RATE_PATH,
  PRIMARY_PRIORITY_PATH
)

missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Required saved outputs are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

cat("Municipalities:", EXPECTED_N_MUNI, "\n")
cat("Matched top-third:", TOP_N, "\n")
cat("Posterior IRR surface:", ST_RATE_PATH, "\n")
cat("Primary File 13 ranking:", PRIMARY_PRIORITY_PATH, "\n")
```

# 1. Load fixed inputs

```{r load-inputs}
st_rate <- readRDS(ST_RATE_PATH) %>%
  mutate(
    ym_date = as.Date(ym_date),
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    )
  )

primary_priority <- readr::read_csv(
  PRIMARY_PRIORITY_PATH,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(
    code_muni = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    code_muni = stringr::str_pad(
      substr(as.character(code_muni), 1, 6),
      width = 6,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    )
  )

required_priority_cols <- c(
  "code_muni",
  "T_irr",
  "V_burden",
  "combined_burden"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_priority_cols %in% names(primary_priority)),
  nrow(primary_priority) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  dplyr::n_distinct(primary_priority$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  all(is.finite(primary_priority$T_irr)),
  all(is.finite(primary_priority$V_burden)),
  all(is.finite(primary_priority$combined_burden))
)

stopifnot(
  all(c("code_muni", "ym_date", "IRR") %in% names(st_rate)),
  all(is.finite(st_rate$IRR))
)

cat(
  "Posterior IRR dates:",
  as.character(min(st_rate$ym_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "to",
  as.character(max(st_rate$ym_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "\n"
)
```

# 2. Rebuild transmission intensity under alternative windows

```{r rebuild-transmission}
make_T_window <- function(dat, years, new_name) {

  ans <- dat %>%
    filter(lubridate::year(ym_date) %in% years) %>%
    group_by(code_muni) %>%
    summarise(
      value = mean(IRR, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_months = sum(is.finite(IRR)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(ans) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
    dplyr::n_distinct(ans$code_muni) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
    all(is.finite(ans$value))
  )

  expected_months <- 12L * length(years)

  if (!all(ans$n_months == expected_months)) {
    warning(
      "Not every municipality has exactly ",
      expected_months,
      " finite monthly IRR values for ",
      new_name,
      "."
    )
  }

  ans %>%
    select(code_muni, value) %>%
    rename(!!new_name := value)
}

T_2024 <- make_T_window(
  st_rate,
  years = 2024,
  new_name = "T_2024"
)

T_2324 <- make_T_window(
  st_rate,
  years = 2023:2024,
  new_name = "T_2324"
)

T_2425_rebuilt <- make_T_window(
  st_rate,
  years = 2024:2025,
  new_name = "T_2425_rebuilt"
)

sensitivity_metric <- primary_priority %>%
  select(
    code_muni,
    V_burden,
    T_2425_saved = T_irr,
    B_2425_saved = combined_burden
  ) %>%
  left_join(T_2024, by = "code_muni") %>%
  left_join(T_2324, by = "code_muni") %>%
  left_join(T_2425_rebuilt, by = "code_muni") %>%
  mutate(
    B_2024 = T_2024 * V_burden,
    B_2324 = T_2324 * V_burden,
    B_2425_rebuilt = T_2425_rebuilt * V_burden
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(sensitivity_metric) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  all(is.finite(sensitivity_metric$B_2024)),
  all(is.finite(sensitivity_metric$B_2324)),
  all(is.finite(sensitivity_metric$B_2425_rebuilt))
)

cat(
  "Max absolute difference between saved and rebuilt 2024-2025 T:",
  max(abs(
    sensitivity_metric$T_2425_saved -
      sensitivity_metric$T_2425_rebuilt
  )),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Max absolute difference between saved and rebuilt 2024-2025 burden:",
  max(abs(
    sensitivity_metric$B_2425_saved -
      sensitivity_metric$B_2425_rebuilt
  )),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    sensitivity_metric$T_2425_saved,
    sensitivity_metric$T_2425_rebuilt,
    tolerance = 1e-10,
    check.attributes = FALSE
  )),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    sensitivity_metric$B_2425_saved,
    sensitivity_metric$B_2425_rebuilt,
    tolerance = 1e-10,
    check.attributes = FALSE
  ))
)
```

# 3. Assign deterministic national ranks

Ranks are generated after sorting by score and then municipality code, so top-third
membership is deterministic even if exact score ties occur.

```{r assign-ranks}
rank_score <- function(dat, score_col, rank_name) {
  dat %>%
    arrange(
      desc(.data[[score_col]]),
      code_muni
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      !!rank_name := row_number()
    ) %>%
    select(code_muni, all_of(rank_name))
}

rank_tables <- list(
  rank_T_2024 = rank_score(
    sensitivity_metric,
    "T_2024",
    "rank_T_2024"
  ),
  rank_T_2324 = rank_score(
    sensitivity_metric,
    "T_2324",
    "rank_T_2324"
  ),
  rank_T_2425 = rank_score(
    sensitivity_metric,
    "T_2425_saved",
    "rank_T_2425"
  ),
  rank_B_2024 = rank_score(
    sensitivity_metric,
    "B_2024",
    "rank_B_2024"
  ),
  rank_B_2324 = rank_score(
    sensitivity_metric,
    "B_2324",
    "rank_B_2324"
  ),
  rank_B_2425 = rank_score(
    sensitivity_metric,
    "B_2425_saved",
    "rank_B_2425"
  )
)

ranked_metric <- sensitivity_metric

for (x in rank_tables) {
  ranked_metric <- ranked_metric %>%
    left_join(x, by = "code_muni")
}

ranked_metric <- ranked_metric %>%
  mutate(
    top_T_2024 = rank_T_2024 <= TOP_N,
    top_T_2324 = rank_T_2324 <= TOP_N,
    top_T_2425 = rank_T_2425 <= TOP_N,
    top_B_2024 = rank_B_2024 <= TOP_N,
    top_B_2324 = rank_B_2324 <= TOP_N,
    top_B_2425 = rank_B_2425 <= TOP_N,

    delta_rank_B_2024_vs_2425 =
      rank_B_2024 - rank_B_2425,

    delta_rank_B_2324_vs_2425 =
      rank_B_2324 - rank_B_2425,

    abs_delta_rank_B_2024_vs_2425 =
      abs(delta_rank_B_2024_vs_2425),

    abs_delta_rank_B_2324_vs_2425 =
      abs(delta_rank_B_2324_vs_2425)
  )

stopifnot(
  sum(ranked_metric$top_B_2024) == TOP_N,
  sum(ranked_metric$top_B_2324) == TOP_N,
  sum(ranked_metric$top_B_2425) == TOP_N
)
```

# 4. Spearman rank correlations

```{r spearman-correlations}
spearman_summary <- tibble::tribble(
  ~metric, ~comparison, ~rho,

  "Transmission intensity",
  "2024 only vs 2024-2025",
  cor(
    ranked_metric$T_2024,
    ranked_metric$T_2425_saved,
    method = "spearman"
  ),

  "Transmission intensity",
  "2023-2024 vs 2024-2025",
  cor(
    ranked_metric$T_2324,
    ranked_metric$T_2425_saved,
    method = "spearman"
  ),

  "Transmission intensity",
  "2024 only vs 2023-2024",
  cor(
    ranked_metric$T_2024,
    ranked_metric$T_2324,
    method = "spearman"
  ),

  "Expected-burden",
  "2024 only vs 2024-2025",
  cor(
    ranked_metric$B_2024,
    ranked_metric$B_2425_saved,
    method = "spearman"
  ),

  "Expected-burden",
  "2023-2024 vs 2024-2025",
  cor(
    ranked_metric$B_2324,
    ranked_metric$B_2425_saved,
    method = "spearman"
  ),

  "Expected-burden",
  "2024 only vs 2023-2024",
  cor(
    ranked_metric$B_2024,
    ranked_metric$B_2324,
    method = "spearman"
  )
)

print(spearman_summary)
```

# 5. Top-third overlap

```{r top-third-overlap}
top_set <- function(dat, indicator_col) {
  dat$code_muni[dat[[indicator_col]]]
}

set_overlap <- function(set_a, set_b, label_a, label_b, metric_name) {

  intersection_n <- length(intersect(set_a, set_b))
  union_n <- length(union(set_a, set_b))

  tibble(
    metric = metric_name,
    comparison = paste(label_a, "vs", label_b),
    n_each = length(set_a),
    intersection_n = intersection_n,
    overlap_share = intersection_n / length(set_a),
    jaccard = intersection_n / union_n,
    entered_vs_reference = length(setdiff(set_a, set_b)),
    left_reference = length(setdiff(set_b, set_a))
  )
}

top_overlap <- bind_rows(
  set_overlap(
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_T_2024"),
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_T_2425"),
    "2024 only",
    "2024-2025",
    "Transmission intensity"
  ),
  set_overlap(
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_T_2324"),
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_T_2425"),
    "2023-2024",
    "2024-2025",
    "Transmission intensity"
  ),
  set_overlap(
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_B_2024"),
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_B_2425"),
    "2024 only",
    "2024-2025",
    "Expected-burden"
  ),
  set_overlap(
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_B_2324"),
    top_set(ranked_metric, "top_B_2425"),
    "2023-2024",
    "2024-2025",
    "Expected-burden"
  )
)

print(top_overlap)
```

# 6. Magnitude of municipality rank changes

```{r rank-shift-summary}
summarize_abs_shift <- function(x, comparison_name) {
  tibble(
    comparison = comparison_name,
    median_abs_rank_change = median(x),
    q75_abs_rank_change = unname(quantile(x, 0.75)),
    q90_abs_rank_change = unname(quantile(x, 0.90)),
    q95_abs_rank_change = unname(quantile(x, 0.95)),
    q99_abs_rank_change = unname(quantile(x, 0.99)),
    max_abs_rank_change = max(x)
  )
}

rank_shift_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarize_abs_shift(
    ranked_metric$abs_delta_rank_B_2024_vs_2425,
    "Expected-burden: 2024 only vs 2024-2025"
  ),
  summarize_abs_shift(
    ranked_metric$abs_delta_rank_B_2324_vs_2425,
    "Expected-burden: 2023-2024 vs 2024-2025"
  )
)

print(rank_shift_summary)
```

# 7. Municipalities crossing the primary top-third boundary

This table identifies municipalities entering or leaving the primary 2024-2025 top third
under each alternative window. It is diagnostic only; it is not a new priority rule.

```{r boundary-crossers}
boundary_crossers <- ranked_metric %>%
  transmute(
    code_muni,

    rank_B_2024,
    rank_B_2324,
    rank_B_2425,

    top_B_2024,
    top_B_2324,
    top_B_2425,

    status_2024_vs_2425 = case_when(
      top_B_2024 & top_B_2425 ~ "Top third in both",
      top_B_2024 & !top_B_2425 ~ "Enters under 2024 only",
      !top_B_2024 & top_B_2425 ~ "Leaves under 2024 only",
      TRUE ~ "Outside top third in both"
    ),

    status_2324_vs_2425 = case_when(
      top_B_2324 & top_B_2425 ~ "Top third in both",
      top_B_2324 & !top_B_2425 ~ "Enters under 2023-2024",
      !top_B_2324 & top_B_2425 ~ "Leaves under 2023-2024",
      TRUE ~ "Outside top third in both"
    )
  )

cat("\n2024-only vs 2024-2025 top-third status:\n")
print(
  boundary_crossers %>%
    count(status_2024_vs_2425) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
)

cat("\n2023-2024 vs 2024-2025 top-third status:\n")
print(
  boundary_crossers %>%
    count(status_2324_vs_2425) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
)
```

# 8. Stability figure

```{r stability-figure, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=4.2}
rank_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  ranked_metric %>%
    transmute(
      reference_rank = rank_B_2425,
      sensitivity_rank = rank_B_2024,
      comparison = "2024 only vs 2024-2025"
    ),
  ranked_metric %>%
    transmute(
      reference_rank = rank_B_2425,
      sensitivity_rank = rank_B_2324,
      comparison = "2023-2024 vs 2024-2025"
    )
)

p_rank_stability <- ggplot(
  rank_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = reference_rank,
    y = sensitivity_rank
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20, size = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = TOP_N,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = TOP_N,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, nrow = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, EXPECTED_N_MUNI),
    breaks = c(1, TOP_N, 3000, 4500, EXPECTED_N_MUNI),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(1, EXPECTED_N_MUNI),
    breaks = c(1, TOP_N, 3000, 4500, EXPECTED_N_MUNI),
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary 2024-2025 expected-burden rank",
    y = "Sensitivity expected-burden rank"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)

print(p_rank_stability)
```

# 10. Final checks

```{r final-checks}
stopifnot(
  nrow(ranked_metric) == EXPECTED_N_MUNI,
  nrow(spearman_summary) == 6L,
  nrow(top_overlap) == 4L,
  all(top_overlap$n_each == TOP_N),
  all(
    spearman_summary$rho >= -1 &
      spearman_summary$rho <= 1
  ),
  all(
    top_overlap$overlap_share >= 0 &
      top_overlap$overlap_share <= 1
  )
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("2025 REPORTING-COMPLETENESS SENSITIVITY COMPLETE\n")
cat("Primary window: 2024-2025\n")
cat("Sensitivity windows: 2024 only; 2023-2024\n")
cat("Top-third:", TOP_N, "of", EXPECTED_N_MUNI, "municipalities\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
```

# Interpretation

The key outputs are:

1. Spearman correlation of municipality rankings;
2. overlap of the top-third municipality sets;
3. distribution of absolute rank changes.

If the alternative-window rankings remain highly concordant with the primary 2024-2025
ranking, this supports the conclusion that the targeting result is not driven by potentially
incomplete late-2025 surveillance.

If rank stability is materially weaker, report the sensitivity directly and use the more
conservative transmission window in the targeting analysis rather than masking the instability.

# Interpretation guardrails

- This sensitivity changes the recent **transmission window only**.
- The severity-burden component is intentionally fixed to the File 13 definition so that the
  analysis isolates possible bias from 2025 reporting completeness.
- `combined_burden` is a relative prioritization score, not a calibrated predicted death count.
- Do not describe rank stability as proof that 2025 surveillance is complete.
- The analysis tests robustness of the municipality prioritization to excluding 2025 data.
